method: Native phrase timestamps from local multilingual Whisper-small, focused retries and FFmpeg measured speech/pause regions (-34dB/min70ms). Caption timing follows actual phrases, not uniform intervals.
visualSubsteps: Color/font/layout use equal thirds of the measured continuous phrase, matching their visual clicks. These are editorial substeps, not word-level timestamps. Archive mouths are original performances under off-screen recap narration.
orthographyCorrections: Wangkap banget teneritaannya -> Lengkap banget penderitaannya
